title: anethum graveolens var. sowa
intro: Anethum graveolens var. sowa, commonly known as Dill, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region and India. It has been used for its culinary and medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, such as bloating and gas. The therapeutic actions of Dill are attributed to its carminative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive discomfort and relieve pain. The bioactive constituents of Dill include carvone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and flavor profile.
